Evidence_Notes: 16 discrete states covering creation, active pipeline, recovery, and 4 terminal outcomes.
Complete linear lifecycle progression CREATED -> COMPLETED validated.
Illegal transitions raise InvalidStateTransitionError leaving current state untouched.
COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT prohibit all outgoing non-identical transitions.
Failure reason preserved in FSM property and StageRecord history.
Separate states and reasons prevent ambiguity between user cancellation and duration timeouts.
Wall-clock entered_at/exited_at with monotonic perf_counter duration measurement.
8 concurrent worker threads verified without deadlocks or race condition errors.
Recovery path enables rehydration from saved SQLite checkpoints without re-running completed stages.
Dispatches real-time state change events across CallbackRegistry and WebSocket Wiretap.
Blackboard partitions automatically sync lifecycle state and stage durations.
Live execution through VALIDATING -> INGESTING -> EXECUTING -> MUTATION_ANALYSIS -> EVALUATING -> COMPLETED.
Polling and cancellation endpoints return lifecycle_state, stage_durations, and stage_history.
